info.title: Rebalancování portfolií
info.description: Rozhodovací podpora pro rebalancování klientských portfolií (návrh, nikoli pokyn k obchodu).

post.description: The current client book (data + strategies) as an .xlsx in the import format.

Assumptions-Input.title: Assumptions
Assumptions-Input.description: System-level model assumptions (doc 08 §2), echoed in every result.

Assumptions-Output.title: Assumptions
Assumptions-Output.description: System-level model assumptions (doc 08 §2), echoed in every result.

Benchmark.title: Benchmark
Benchmark.description:
The simple rule: when a band (on today's total-asset weights) is breached, rebalance fully to target now;
otherwise do nothing. Compared with the recommendation on the same simulation.

Issue.title: Issue
Issue.description: Validation issue with a sheet/cell reference (doc 08 §12).

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: One value-dated cash movement and the settled balance of its currency after it (doc 08 §5).

Policy-Input.title: Policy
Policy-Input.description: Per-client rebalancing policy (doc 08 §4). Legislation is never a policy parameter.

Policy-Output.title: Policy
Policy-Output.description: Per-client rebalancing policy (doc 08 §4). Legislation is never a policy parameter.

ReserveBridge.title: ReserveBridge
ReserveBridge.description: How today's cash requirement is built (doc 09 §3 „reserve bridge“), all values from the engine.

Snapshot.title: Snapshot
Snapshot.description: Dataset + policies + result: what the UI holds in memory (no server state).

StressOut.title: StressOut
StressOut.description: Illustrative equity drawdown: loss in CZK and % of NAV today, at the target allocation and after the plan.

Summary.title: Summary
Summary.description: What to do and why, in one line — chosen by fixed rules from the evaluation.

Tag.title: Tag
Tag.description:
Short reason attached to an order or a decision: a rule code plus its numbers.

kind: reason (why the order exists) | info (cost or condition) | warning (check before trading).
